target: hemolysis percentage at reported exact molar concentration
molecular_scope: 5–50 standard-AA, L, linear, no other MAP tags, free/acetyl N, acid/amide C
environment_scope: dose and reported red-blood-cell species; no time/temperature model; pH collected but not fitted
group_rule: transitive clusters with unit-cost global edit distance <= floor(0.2*max sequence length); not standard identity/CD-HIT
evaluation: 5fold edit clusters; separately5fold paper holdout with all shared sequence clusters purged; per chemical-form weights
limitations: no claim of independent GHXTox benchmark or mechanistic causality
